Subject: Initial TIA request & UK Addendum questions

Diego —

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting procurement for the pilot (Arden Health / Redwood POC) and legal has asked us to confirm a few things before we can sign the MSA. High level asks:

- Confirmation that Redwood's TIA (DTIA) mapping covers processing in the UK with the UK Addendum/IDTA applied.
- A short evidence pack showing: (a) subprocessor list with geographic processing locations, (b) encryption in transit + at rest, (c) retention policy and deletion procedures for PHI-like datasets.
- If any processing flows rely on US-based subs (or cloud regions), please confirm safeguards and fallback routing for UK residents.

I've attached Arden's TIA intake PDF with their desired timeline (two-week window). Can your team review and flag the non-starters? We're aiming to close contracting by 12/22.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Procurement Manager, Arden Health

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@ardenhealth.ai>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Thomas Lee <thomas.lee@ardenhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial TIA request & UK Addendum questions

Hi all — I did a first pass on the intake and the attached DPA redlines. Summary / decision log (high level):

1) UK Addendum / IDTA: Redwood can accept the UK Addendum with our standard tech and organizational measures. We will need to add a short clause clarifying routing policy for UK-resident data and the fallback to EU-region processing as the preferred option.

2) SCCs + DTIAs: For EU resident data we will apply SCCs for controller-processor flows per the standard template. We recommend bundling the SCC mapping with a TIA spreadsheet that lists subprocessor, region, and whether data is pseudonymized.

3) Subprocessors: The attached evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx is the format we use. We'll need Arden to confirm any vendor-facing integrations that call external APIs (those often change routing).

4) PHI & retention: Proposed compromise — Redwood will document retention/deletion workflows (data retention policy + export/delete runbook) and commit to a quarterly attestation for production logs relating to deletion. For high-sensitivity PHI fields, we can discuss field-level pseudonymization or a dedicated dedicated-on-prem connector for the pilot (cost/ops trade-off).

Open items for Arden to provide:
- Final DPA redline (we got a greenshot but need the full markup)
- Specific example payloads showing PHI fields (so we can map token-level CEs)
- Whether any processing must strictly remain in the UK (if yes, we'll map to our UK-region Dedicated offering).

I propose the following next steps:
- By EOD Monday: Redwood sends the evidence matrix filled with best-effort entries.
- Tuesday: 1-hour alignment call (we'll propose times) to go through redlines and any remaining blockers.

If Arden wants model-specific mitigations (e.g., quantization or field-level removal), that will likely be a short engineering sprint and we should capture expected turnaround in the decision log.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security — Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx

We'll surface a final stance on the call.

Quick security note before the call:

- We can provide encryption-in-transit and at-rest attestations (TLS v1.2+, AES-256 at rest) and a network diagram for where keys are managed (KMS region).
- For subprocessor routing, we'll produce a matrix that includes a fallback policy: if a UK-specific processing node is unavailable, requests for UK-resident identifiers will be routed to an EU-only processing domain and logged as a fallback event. That fallback event will be surfaced in the audit logs and Redwood will agree to a notification SLA (1 business day) for any fallback incidents during the pilot.
- If Arden requires *strict* UK-only processing for identifiers, engineering estimates a 3–4 week effort to provision Dedicated UK-only nodes for the pilot (scope and cost TBD).

I'll bring a draft evidence pack and short decision log to the call.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
